bagPolicy.summary: Bags are prohibited except small bags no larger than 5 x 8 x 1 inches, medically necessary bags, and reasonably sized diaper bags. Permitted exceptions are subject to inspection.
allowed: Small bags up to 5 x 8 x 1 inches
prohibited: Bags larger than 5 x 8 x 1 inches without an exception
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking and tailgating must remain within designated stalls and travel lanes. Tailgating may occur directly in front of or behind a vehicle; charcoal and open-flame wood grills are prohibited.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Marriott Center. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drink, including bottled water, is not allowed inside the Marriott Center for arena events.

accessibility.summary: Guests needing disability accommodations may contact the University Accessibility Center, and the arena provides accessible seating and guest-service support.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is allowed only when the guest has the ticket or ROC pass exit-scanned before leaving, then presents it for re-scan on return.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Public and player-guest will call are at the main Marriott Center Ticket Office on the north side of the building.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: For BYU men's basketball games, all entrances open about 60 minutes before the published tip-off time. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
